title: Pour House
venue_description:
Pour House - South Oceanside Music Venue

Founded in 2014 Pour House has established itself as a premier live music destination in South Oceanside California. Located at 1903 South Coast Highway this waterfront dive bar offers world-class dining liquor and entertainment seven nights a week.

Music & Events

Pour House features live music Wednesday through Sunday nights with Wednesdays dedicated to open mic nights. The venue hosts an array of talent from international artists to notable San Diego county bands and up-and-coming Oceanside musicians. The intimate stage provides a platform for emerging local talent to showcase their skills.

Atmosphere & Amenities

The venue offers a satisfying establishment for the discerning patron with both indoor and outdoor seating options. Outdoor dining areas include heated patios perfect for enjoying live music year-round. A full bar menu and comfort food options including mac and cheese and truffle fries are available. Trivia nights occur regularly providing additional entertainment options.

Community Focus

Pour House serves as a gathering place for the local music community providing opportunities for musicians of all levels to perform. The friendly atmosphere attracts both regulars and visitors creating a vibrant social scene. The venue welcomes catering inquiries and special events.

title: Belching Beaver Brewery Oceanside
venue_description:
Belching Beaver Brewery - Oceanside Location

Launched in 2012 Belching Beaver Brewery evolved from a desire to make great beer and have a Dam Good Time doing it. The Oceanside location at 1334 Rocky Point Drive showcases the companys commitment to quality craft beer and community engagement.

Craft Beer Selection

Belching Beaver offers an extensive range of expertly crafted beers including easy-drinking Blondes Triple IPAs Milk Stouts Imperial Stouts sours and barrel-aged beers. Each beer release carries its own individual style and personality reflecting the companys philosophy of brewing for everyone and all palates.

Live Music & Entertainment

The Oceanside brewery hosts open mic nights on the first Saturday of each month starting at 6:00 PM. The spacious outdoor patio provides an ideal setting for live performances. Sound system microphones and guitars are provided for performers. The brewery also features trivia nights on Mondays from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM and various live music events throughout the week.

Family & Pet Friendly

The venue welcomes families and well-behaved dogs on leashes. Ample parking and seating both indoors and outdoors accommodate groups of all sizes. Rotating food truck vendors provide diverse dining options complementing the beer selections.

Community Connection

Belching Beaver serves as a hub for the local Oceanside community fostering camaraderie among visitors. The brewery regularly hosts special events fam jams and community gatherings making it more than just a place to grab a drink but a center for social connection.

title: Coastal Music Studios
venue_description:
Coastal Music Studios - Performance Venue & Teaching Studio

Established in 2012 Coastal Music Studios is a premier music and teaching studio serving North San Diego County. Located at 1006 Mission Avenue Suite E the studio has become a beloved community space for music education and live performance.

Professional Performance Space

The studio features a professional performance stage equipped with full sound and lighting systems. Coastal Music LIVE provides a quality performance opportunity with a 150-inch screen and professional audio setup. The venue regularly hosts band shows student performances and special music events.

All Ages Open Mic Nights

Open Mic Nights at Coastal Music Studios have become a favorite for students families and the broader Oceanside community. These all-ages events feature a chill coffeehouse vibe and welcome performers of all skill levels. Performers can play solo or with groups on any instrument or with pre-recorded tracks. Performance spots are scheduled first-come first-scheduled basis with approximately two hours of live music per event.

Teaching & Community Programs

Beyond performances Coastal Music Studios offers private music lessons group music sessions early childhood music and movement classes and performance coaching. The studio is founded by Andy and Pam Allen who bring twenty years of experience as touring musicians and music educators to the community.

Atmosphere & Amenities

The studio maintains a welcoming and safe environment for artistic expression. Coffee nonalcoholic beverages and snacks are available for purchase. The venue also hosts special events like the 13th Annual Christmas 4 Kidz Charity Concert and seasonal band showcase events.
location: 1006 Mission Avenue Suite E Oceanside CA 92054

title: Coomber Craft Wines
venue_description:
Coomber Craft Wines - Oceanside Winery & Tasting Room

Coomber Craft Wines is an award-winning winery and tasting room located in downtown Oceanside at 611 Mission Avenue. The venue specializes in small-batch California-style wines and has established itself as a premier destination for wine enthusiasts and live music lovers.

Wine Selection & Production

Coomber produces award-winning wines from grapes purchased throughout California. The tasting room offers flights of distinctive varietals and blends including Riesling Pinot Noir and barrel-aged Cabernet. As the number three winery in San Diego County according to Yelp ratings Coomber maintains high quality standards and offers wine club membership for enthusiasts.

Live Music & Entertainment

The venue features live entertainment nightly creating a vibrant atmosphere for guests. Local musicians and acoustic performers regularly grace the intimate setting. The expansive back patio provides ample seating for nightly performances with reserved seatings available at 5:30 PM and 7:30 PM.

Food & Dining

Coomber now makes artisan pizza nightly complementing the wine selections perfectly. Charcuterie trays are available for pairing with wine selections. The warm and inviting atmosphere encourages guests to linger and enjoy the experience with friends and family.

Community & Ambiance

Located in downtown Oceanside Coomber Craft Wines has created a welcoming space where patrons can relax enjoy exceptional wines and experience live music. The philosophy centers on believing that having fun should be part of the wine experience. The venue welcomes all ages early in the evening and is kid-friendly with dogs welcome on patios.
